# OSM:prime

Start here when the configured instruction selects Prime or the user asks to
prime a task. Start with the user's request and applicable project instructions.
A scheduled Dreaming run uses its own entrypoint. A scoped worker uses the
inputs selected by the lead.

1. Resolve the scope before opening a source. A task that can clearly be solved
   within an independent project uses its local instructions and sources only.
   General questions without owner context also need no Notion access. Honor
   an explicit project or client context boundary before the personal default.
2. For other tasks, resolve the Notion root on the `Data and Context:` line
   (or the existing `Context:` line). Read that line from the host's persistent
   instruction file or, if the host has none, from its built-in persistent
   memory or standing instructions, then open the root through the host's
   authorized connection.
   If the root is missing or unreadable, identify the missing prerequisite and
   continue independent work. Use only the selected home and account.
3. Follow [Manage Data & Context](https://github.com/onlinesourdough/OSM-plugin/blob/17b05b360eb32ab3bdf3ad80d45f2ad2cd06d55b/skills/osm-manage-data-context/index.md) for
   retrieval. Read the Data and Context Definition and its required controls
   once, then use metadata to find only what the task needs. Use a scoped
   Memory query for a past decision and the selected
   history or project source for unfinished work or an activity recap. Verify
   a live fact at its owning source when the result depends on it.
   Treat the definition as a gateway, not a request to import every source.
   Follow each source's permitted use, processing environment and retention
   rules before reading it. For example, query accounting in its selected
   accounting tool; do not mirror its records into Notion. Permission to read
   a source is separate from permission to retain or share its contents.
4. If you find a verified context error, correct the lookup or conclusion now.
   Use the shared [repair rules](https://github.com/onlinesourdough/OSM-plugin/blob/17b05b360eb32ab3bdf3ad80d45f2ad2cd06d55b/skills/osm-manage-data-context/references/activity.md#repair-in-the-current-session)
   for an authorized stored repair and a short note for Dreaming.
5. Use the relevant result, then proceed with the user's actual request. In
   this session reuse verified context; refresh the affected source only when
   the task, home, scope, freshness or access changes.

Prime keeps its work inside the selected home and scope. Report concrete gaps
when they affect the result.

40d6d2e17f5681f8bdf6c519aee306b5.title: OSM:setup
40d6d2e17f5681f8bdf6c519aee306b5.body:
[Exact instruction source](https://github.com/onlinesourdough/OSM-plugin/blob/17b05b360eb32ab3bdf3ad80d45f2ad2cd06d55b/skills/osm-setup/SKILL.md) · commit `17b05b360eb3`. Use the instructions supplied with your installed version.

# OSM:setup

Conduct onboarding from a connected Notion workspace to a verified home and a
useful first task. Reuse answers; resume at the next gap.

Codex **Set up** or an explicit request starts this skill. Resume accepted setup
and connections. Verify access; a badge or saved link is not readiness. For
package installation or a requested bridge-only change, use the
[adapter route](https://github.com/onlinesourdough/OSM-plugin/blob/17b05b360eb32ab3bdf3ad80d45f2ad2cd06d55b/skills/osm-setup/references/adapters.md). Installation alone creates no home and
needs no global instruction edit. Use the [Notion access](https://github.com/onlinesourdough/OSM-plugin/blob/17b05b360eb32ab3bdf3ad80d45f2ad2cd06d55b/skills/osm-setup/references/panel.md) procedure for Codex connection checks.
Use the [procedure index](https://github.com/onlinesourdough/OSM-plugin/blob/17b05b360eb32ab3bdf3ad80d45f2ad2cd06d55b/skills/osm/index.md) for earlier names and package recovery.

## One path

Setup is the single conductor. Each step has one owner. In the chain of Setup,
Data & Context, Manage Data & Context and Manage Skills nothing calls back into
Setup (Interview links Setup only for a new connection, which is conditional and
outside that chain):

1. **Connection and access.** Inspect exposed connections first and reuse a
   working connection or recorded choice. For new ordinary user setup, check
   whether the official Notion plugin is installed and connected. When its
   installation is authorized, install it through the supported host route,
   guide account connection and verify the intended workspace with a scoped
   safe read. Use a
   dedicated connection when the selected team, worker or unattended workflow
   needs its own identity or access scope. Preserve an existing recorded choice.
   Unavailable or declined access stays an explicit gap while other work
   continues. If the selected route requires a credential or rotation, use
   [credential setup and verification](https://github.com/onlinesourdough/OSM-plugin/blob/17b05b360eb32ab3bdf3ad80d45f2ad2cd06d55b/skills/osm-setup/references/credentials.md).
   No secrets in chat or context.
2. **Understand the business.** Use the [business coverage check](https://github.com/onlinesourdough/OSM-plugin/blob/17b05b360eb32ab3bdf3ad80d45f2ad2cd06d55b/skills/osm-setup/references/business-context.md)
   for goals, offers, customers, positioning and systems, reusing what the
   workspace already shows. [Interview](https://github.com/onlinesourdough/OSM-plugin/blob/17b05b360eb32ab3bdf3ad80d45f2ad2cd06d55b/skills/osm-interview/SKILL.md) only where
   material context is missing, with its
   [owner-context guide](https://github.com/onlinesourdough/OSM-plugin/blob/17b05b360eb32ab3bdf3ad80d45f2ad2cd06d55b/skills/osm-interview/references/owner-context.md); never a
   fixed questionnaire.
3. **Map selected sources and authority.** Record which systems are sources,
   which are working artifacts and who has authority. External systems, local
   files and repositories remain sources or artifacts, never an alternate home.
   The definition is the business's gateway: record when to use each source,
   its real access route, permitted actions and processing environment, and
   what may be retained where. Keep operational originals in their system.
   An AI-native source normally needs direct lookup, not a Notion importer.
   Reuse its existing connection and configure the template to the business.
4. **Reuse or create.** [Data & Context](https://github.com/onlinesourdough/OSM-plugin/blob/17b05b360eb32ab3bdf3ad80d45f2ad2cd06d55b/skills/osm-data-context/index.md) engineers
   the home, its definition and the core Knowledge, Memory and Skills roles:
   existing stores are reused by actual ID, only missing ones are created, and
   replay creates no duplicate. For a new home, include the
   [Content foundation](https://github.com/onlinesourdough/OSM-plugin/blob/17b05b360eb32ab3bdf3ad80d45f2ad2cd06d55b/skills/osm-data-context/references/notion/content-foundation.md)
   in the short plan: reuse an existing Notion or authoritative external route,
   record a deferral, or propose one empty store. Personal Content methods stay
   optional. Never retrofit an established home on normal resume. It discovers the actual
   types and metadata of existing stores before mapping and follows the architecture's
   [record lifecycle](https://github.com/onlinesourdough/OSM-plugin/blob/17b05b360eb32ab3bdf3ad80d45f2ad2cd06d55b/skills/osm-data-context/references/architecture.md#record-lifecycle).
   A newly generated root body starts with the definition, followed by its
   databases. Changes to an existing root follow the owner's request and write
   policy. Explain onboarding in the conversation, using the public guide's
   durable description when useful.
5. **Adopt.** Record the owner's write policy once: whole-home proposed, never
   assumed. Save the thin host pointer in the host's persistent instruction
   file or, if the host has none, in its built-in persistent memory or standing
   instructions. Add it only at the intended scope.
6. **Optional upkeep.** [Manage Data & Context](https://github.com/onlinesourdough/OSM-plugin/blob/17b05b360eb32ab3bdf3ad80d45f2ad2cd06d55b/skills/osm-manage-data-context/index.md)
   serves manual and task-time curation, and [Dreaming](https://github.com/onlinesourdough/OSM-plugin/blob/17b05b360eb32ab3bdf3ad80d45f2ad2cd06d55b/skills/osm-dreaming/SKILL.md)
   is the entry for reflection across recent work and scheduled upkeep. Setting
   up a schedule on the host's scheduler or routines, if available, needs an
   explicit request and exact authority. Record only
   history and source routes that are actually readable;
   an unavailable or unqualified route stays an explicit gap.
7. **First useful task.** Complete the agreed result, then check the
   [setup scenarios](https://github.com/onlinesourdough/OSM-plugin/blob/17b05b360eb32ab3bdf3ad80d45f2ad2cd06d55b/skills/osm-setup/references/setup-scenarios.md) that apply and report
   unavailable proof honestly. An unchanged resume needs only its task checks.

Follow [setup](https://github.com/onlinesourdough/OSM-plugin/blob/17b05b360eb32ab3bdf3ad80d45f2ad2cd06d55b/skills/osm-setup/references/setup.md) for the questions, readiness and acceptance
details, and [bootstrap](https://github.com/onlinesourdough/OSM-plugin/blob/17b05b360eb32ab3bdf3ad80d45f2ad2cd06d55b/skills/osm-setup/references/bootstrap.md) for the first-run sequence of a
new root. For personal skills during setup, call Manage Skills'
[personal skill lifecycle](https://github.com/onlinesourdough/OSM-plugin/blob/17b05b360eb32ab3bdf3ad80d45f2ad2cd06d55b/skills/osm-manage-skills/references/owner-skills.md). When
an owner asks in ordinary language for local guardrails during autonomous use,
route that request to [Manage Skills](https://github.com/onlinesourdough/OSM-plugin/blob/17b05b360eb32ab3bdf3ad80d45f2ad2cd06d55b/skills/osm-manage-skills/index.md); normal setup does not
depend on an optional guard implementation.

## Boundaries

- Notion is the only supported context home. A legacy folder, vault or
  `AIOS_FORMAT` home is recognized read-only and left untouched; the
  [update procedure](https://github.com/onlinesourdough/OSM-plugin/blob/17b05b360eb32ab3bdf3ad80d45f2ad2cd06d55b/skills/osm/references/update.md#legacy-file-and-vault-homes)
  gives the honest incompatibility and migration guidance. Setup offers no
  file or vault option.
- Never interrupt unrelated work, restart established setup or infer install
  authority. Do not install anything or change global settings unless the
  current task authorizes it. Preserve unrelated instructions, secrets and
  configuration keys.
- Keep the product version and the owner's stored compatibility names separate.
  Persisted names such as `AIOS:BEGIN` blocks and the panel's `aios` directory
  remain readable; they are compatibility keys, not branding.
